snippet.title: Slam Poets on PartyMashup.com 🪩
snippet.description:
How to play Slam Poets:

1. Go to PartyMashup.com
2. Click 'Host a Party' and select Slam Poets, then share your join code with your friends
3. Have your friends enter the join code to jump in
4. Play Slam Poets and make heart-touching or ghoulishly cringe poetry

Slam Poets is for 2-5 players, average play time is 10 minutes. Enjoy, you beautiful poets!
